entry.title: F4 Phantom 1.1.0
entry.summary: # F4 Phantom 1.1.0 An 8-voice subtractive synthesizer: two oscillators plus a sub, SVF filter, analog drift, stereo chorus and a six-barrel rotary gate (VULCAN). 14 programs. **Not yet tested on a real MPC** (checked with Akai's `host_sim` and Open MPC's catalog check). Reports welcome: device, MPC OS version, what happened. Two zips: `*-mpc-armv7.zip` for Gen1 (Live, Live II, One, X, Key 61/37, Force) and `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` for Gen2 (Live III, One G2, Key G2, XL). ## Requirements - A first-gen
